title: DECISION: atomic temp-file-rename for blob writes
description: BlobStore::write_blob writes to <id>.tmp, calls sync_all, then renames atomically to <id>. Alternative considered: write directly to the final path. Rejected because a crash mid-write would leave a partial file visible to readers as a valid blob. The rename approach guarantees that a file at <id> is either absent or fully written. Trade-off: crash between sync_all and rename leaves an orphan .tmp; harmless since no DB row points to it. Location: crates/kith-attach/src/lib.rs BlobStore::write_blob.
